discipline_just_cause_001.evidence: No teacher will be disciplined, reprimanded, reduced in rank or compensation or deprived of any professional advantage without cause.

discipline_dismissal_002.evidence: The Board of Education will accept the resignation of any non-tenured Unit I employee submitted prior to May 1 without prejudice, provided that the said employee has not been recommended by the Superintendent for Termination or non-renewal due to cause.
